title: How AI agents negotiate prices autonomously

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI can now haggle over prices faster than you can say "deal"?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech is changing how companies set prices in real time — and it’s here now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI agents use machine learning to negotiate deals on your behalf, instantly and autonomously.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: One system, called AutoNeg, uses game theory to find the best price in seconds.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It affects everything from online shopping to global trade deals — imagine that.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? AI is becoming the ultimate dealmaker in the digital world.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how it’s changing the future of commerce? Follow for the breakdown.
